# Body

- **GET** `/groceries/${id}` - Retrieves the grocery with the given ID.
  Returns a JSON object containing only the `name` and an empty list of 
  `ingredients`. The response should have a status code of **200** and a JSON object 
  containing only the `name` and an empty list of `ingredients`. If no groceries
  match with the provided ID, it should return a JSON object containing an 
  error message indicating that no grocery was found with the specified ID.

- **POST** `/groceries` - Adds a new grocery with the provided name and 
  quantity.
  The response should have a status code of **201** and an empty JSON object 
  containing only the `name` and an empty list of `ingredients`. If a grocery with 
  this name already exists, it should return a JSON object containing an 
  error message indicating that the grocery with this name already exists.

- **PUT** `/groceries/${id}` - Updates an existing grocery with the specified name and 
  quantity.
  The response should have a status code of **204** and an empty JSON object 
  containing only the `name` and a list of ingredients. If no groceries match with 
  the provided ID, it should return a JSON object containing an 
  error message indicating that no grocery was found with the specified ID.

- **DELETE** `/groceries/${id}` - Deletes a grocery with the given ID.
  The response should have a status code of **204** and an empty JSON object 
  containing only the `name` and a list of ingredients. If no groceries match with 
  the provided ID, it should return a JSON object containing an 
  error message indicating that no grocery was found with the specified ID.

class Api::V1::GroceriesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_grocery, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]

  # GET /api/v1/groceries
  def index
    @groceries = Grocery.all
    render json: @groceries
  end

  # GET /api/v1/groceries/1
  def show
    render json: @grocery
  end

  # POST /api/v1/groceries
  def create
    @grocery = Grocery.new(grocery_params)

    if @grocery.save
      render json: @grocery, status: :created, location: api_v1_grocery_url(@grocery)
    else
      render json: @grocery.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  # PATCH/PUT /api/v1/groceries/1
  def update
    if @grocery.update(grocery_params)
      render json: @grocery
    else
      render json: @grocery.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/groceries/1
  def destroy
    @grocery.destroy
  end

  private
    # Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
    def set_grocery
      @grocery = Grocery.find(params[:id])
    end

    # Only allow a trusted parameter "white list" through.
    def grocery_params
      params.require(:grocery).permit(:name, :quantity)
    end

  use MyApp.Web, :controller

  alias MyApp.Grocery

  def index(conn, _params) do
    groceries = Repo.all(Grocery)
    render(conn, "index.json", groceries: groceries)
  end

  def show(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    grocery = Repo.get!(Grocery, id)
    render(conn, "show.json", grocery: grocery)
  end

  def create(conn, %{"grocery" => grocery_params}) do
    changeset = Grocery.changeset(%Grocery{}, grocery_params)

    case Repo.insert(changeset) do
      {:ok, grocery} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> put_resp_header("location", grocery_path(conn, :show, grocery))
        |> render("show.json", grocery: grocery)

      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        |> render(MyApp.ChangesetView, "error.json", changeset: changeset)
    end
  end

  def update(conn, %{"id" => id, "grocery" => grocery_params}) do
    grocery = Repo.get!(Grocery, id)
    changeset = Grocery.changeset(grocery, grocery_params)

    case Repo.update(changeset) do
      {:ok, grocery} ->
